release.notes: Class Games and Activity Records now have clearer names. Added Spell Fix with Question Bank and CSV authoring, a side-by-side teacher preview, raised letter tiles, one-letter reveal/undo and a per-letter bell. Completed shared calling cycles restart automatically on the next selection. Word Scramble preserves spaces and word order. Added a saved Prayer Bank with CSV import, student-led and class chorus modes, and readable paged prayer text. Existing attendance filters, scores, separate steal rotation, saved backgrounds and music are preserved.
